p: old and stricken in years: He was about 70 years old, 2Sa 5:4.
heat: For his natural heat was worn away with travels.
a Shunammite: A city in the tribe of Issachar, Jos 19:18.
fifty men to run before him: Read 2Sa 15:1.
helped him: They took his part and followed him.
the mighty men: As the Cherethites and Pelethites.
life: For Adonijah will destroy you and your son, if he reigns.
confirm thy words: By declaring such things, as may further the same.
it not: The king being worn with age, could not attend to the affairs of the realm, and also Adonijah had many who kept it from the king.
counted offenders: And so put to death as wicked transgressors.
to the ground: Acknowledging him to be the true and worthy king appointed by God, as the figure of his Christ.
servant: Meaning, that in such affairs he should undertake nothing unless he had consulted with the Lord.
sware unto thee by the LORD: Moved by the Spirit of God to do so, because he foresaw that Solomon would be the figure of Christ.
servants of your lord: Meaning, the king's servants and such as were of his guard.
oil out of the tabernacle: With which they were accustomed to anoint the priests and the holy instruments, Ex 30:23.
good tidings: He praised Jonathan, thinking to have heard good news but God wrought things contrary to his expectation, and so beat down his pride.
bed: He gave God thanks for the good success.
altar: Which David his father had built in the floor of Araunah, 2Sa 24:25.
